items.headline: BYU's Sitake disputes roughing the kicker call in 2OT, but UCF 'bested us'
items.description: BYU coach Kalani Sitake disagreed with a roughing the kicker penalty that led to UCF's eventual winning score, but he refused to call the loss a letdown.

items.headline: Keyone Jenkins throws TD pass in double OT and UCF knocks off No. 2 BYU 39-31
items.description: — Keyone Jenkins threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to tight end Grayson Brousseau in the second overtime, and UCF survived a wild finish in regulation to knock off No. 2 BYU 39-31 on Saturday.
